:forall: Universal quantifier — holds for every element.
:exists: Existential quantifier — at least one element works.
:existsone: Unique existence — exactly one element works.
:lor: Logical or — at least one statement holds.
:bigwedge: Conjunction over a range with bounds.
:bigvee: Disjunction over a range with bounds.
:implies: Implication — a long arrow with proper spacing.
:impliedby: Reverse implication — the left follows from the right.
:iff: If and only if — logical equivalence.
:models: Satisfies — the structure is a model of the formula.
:vdash: Proves — the formula is derivable from the theory.
:dashv: Reverse turnstile; also left adjoint to.
:suchthat: Upright “s.t.” for use inside a formula.
:wlog: Upright “w.l.o.g.” for use inside a formula.
